alex: starting the early oncall shift in ~20m, doing a quick access priming. can folks confirm these before i go green? checklist:
- runbook: https://internal/runbooks/oncall-core (please confirm latest)
- pagerduty: test notification + escalation policy check
- vpn: corp-vpn profile applied and connected
- ssh keys: deploy key present for infra repo
- creds: infra-monitor service token validity
- tooling: kibana/logs + tracing dashboard access

marta: running through now. runbook looks up-to-date (last edit 2026-02-12). i can trigger a PD test if you want. vpn ok from my end.

devops-bot: Automated checks:
- PagerDuty access: OK for alex, marta
- VPN profile: OK for marta, raj
- SSH key validity: alex MISSING deploy key for infra repo
- Service token expiry: infra-monitor svc token expires in 9 days
Full report: https://internal/reports/oncall-check/2035678901

alex: thanks @devops-bot. @raj @lia can you help reprovision alex's deploy key and rotate infra-monitor token? prefer rotation before i take the shift.

raj: on it. creating new deploy keypair now. will push pubkey to infra repo and DM private key to alex via secure channel (1Password/secure DM).

lia: scheduled token rotation; will coordinate with raj to avoid breaking alerts. ETA ~15m. i'll post a brief note in #incidents if anything changes.

sam: heads-up — if token rotation affects alerting, fallback policy `infra-fallback` routes to ops-team. i'll watch the routing while you rotate.

alex: running a couple quick smoke checks as soon as keys are up:
`ssh -i ~/.ssh/oncall_infra git@github.com:org/infra.git`
`pd test notify --user alex`
will post results.

alex: ssh succeeded after raj pushed key. PD test delivered and acknowledged. kibana query `logs: query service:infra* | last 15m` returned recent entries — logs access OK.

marta: all set from my side, marking checklist DONE :thumbsup:

alex: appreciate it — i'll append the exact steps + timing to the runbook (token rotation at T+10m, key push at T+3m) and note the temporary maintenance window. paging channel is primary for my shift, DM for low-priority. ping if anything spikes.
